title: いちばん簡単なプログラム: 値を積んで、取り出して計算する
titleEn: The simplest program: push values, pop them, and compute
source:
# The simplest program: push values, pop them, and compute
a = 1
b = 2
c = a + b
puts c

title: 条件分岐: branchunless でジャンプする様子を見てみよう
source:
# Conditionals: watch branchunless jump
x = 7
if x > 5
  puts "big"
else
  puts "small"
end

title: while ループ: 後ろ向きの jump で繰り返す
titleEn: while loops: repeat with a backward jump
source:
# while loops: repeat with a backward jump
i = 0
sum = 0
while i < 5
  sum += i
  i += 1
end
puts sum

title: メソッド呼び出し: 積んだ引数がそのまま呼び出し先のローカル変数になる
titleEn: Method calls: pushed arguments become the callee's local variables
source:
# Method calls: pushed arguments become the callee's local variables
def add(a, b)
  a + b
end

def square(x)
  x * x
end

puts add(square(3), 4)

title: 再帰呼び出し: フレームが積まれては外れる
titleEn: Recursion: frames are pushed and popped
source:
# Recursion: frames are pushed and popped
def fib(n)
  if n < 2
    n
  else
    fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
  end
end

puts fib(5)

title: ブロック: getlocal_WC_1 で 1 つ外側の変数を読み書きする
titleEn: Blocks: read and write the outer variable with getlocal_WC_1
source:
# Blocks: read and write the outer variable with getlocal_WC_1
sum = 0
[1, 2, 3].each do |x|
  sum += x * 10
end
puts sum

squares = (1..4).map { |n| n * n }
p squares

title: クラス定義: defineclass / definemethod と、インスタンス変数
titleEn: Class definitions: defineclass / definemethod and instance variables
source:
# Class definitions: defineclass / definemethod and instance variables
class Counter
  def initialize(start)
    @count = start
  end

  def up(step = 1)
    @count += step
    self
  end

  def to_s
    "Counter(#{@count})"
  end
end

c = Counter.new(10)
c.up.up(5)
puts c

title: 文字列と式展開: objtostring / concatstrings
source:
# Strings and interpolation: objtostring / concatstrings
name = "Ruby"
version = 4
msg = "Hello, #{name} #{version}!"
puts msg
puts msg.upcase
puts msg.length

title: 例外処理: 例外ハンドラ表 (catch table) から rescue 節を見つける
titleEn: Exceptions: find the rescue clause via the catch table
source:
# Exceptions: find the rescue clause via the catch table
def divide(a, b)
  a / b
rescue ZeroDivisionError => e
  puts "error: #{e.message}"
  0
ensure
  puts "divide done"
end

puts divide(10, 2)
puts divide(1, 0)

title: 継承と super
source:
# Inheritance and super
class Animal
  def initialize(name)
    @name = name
  end

  def speak
    "#{@name} makes a sound"
  end
end

class Dog < Animal
  def speak
    super + " (Woof!)"
  end
end

animals = [Animal.new("Cat"), Dog.new("Pochi")]
animals.each { |a| puts a.speak }

title: ハッシュと配列の組み合わせ
source:
# Combining hashes and arrays
scores = { alice: 80, bob: 65, carol: 92 }
scores[:dave] = 70
passed = scores.select { |name, score| score >= 70 }
passed.each do |name, score|
  puts "#{name}: #{score}"
end
p scores.values.sum

title: yield: invokeblock で自作メソッドからブロックを呼ぶ
titleEn: yield: call a block from your own method with invokeblock
source:
# yield: call a block from your own method with invokeblock
def twice
  yield 1
  yield 2
end

twice { |n| puts n * 100 }

def find_first(list)
  list.each do |x|
    return x if x > 2
  end
  nil
end
p find_first([1, 2, 3, 4])

title: クロージャ: Proc が捕まえた環境は、スタックからヒープへ移る
titleEn: Closures: the environment captured by a Proc moves from the stack to the heap
source:
# Closures: the environment captured by a Proc moves from the stack to the heap
def make_counter
  count = 0
  -> { count += 1 }
end

counter = make_counter
counter.call
counter.call
p counter.call

title: break と ensure: throw 命令でフレームをまたいで脱出する
titleEn: break and ensure: the throw instruction escapes across frames
source:
# break and ensure: the throw instruction escapes across frames
result = [10, 20, 30].each do |x|
  begin
    break x * 2 if x == 20
  ensure
    puts "ensure (x = #{x})"
  end
end
p result
